summary: Iteration 2 e2e testing of new features (real .docx template, note field, DocumentPreviewDialog, /api/stats, batch-print merged PDF, sidebar nav, Dashboard, Settings). Backend: expanded /app/backend/tests/test_contracts_api.py from 13→19 tests, all 19/19 PASS in ~10s: fields count updated to 17, /api/stats returns {total,this_month,datasets,recent}, /api/sample-template returns valid xlsx, /api/contracts/preview with note='TEST_ManualNoteXYZ' includes 'Дополнительно: TEST_ManualNoteXYZ' in document.xml; with note='' the string 'Дополнительно:' is absent (conditional {%p if note %}…{%p endif %} works), /api/contracts/batch-print returns merged application/pdf (%PDF magic, ≥2 pages via pypdf), and the seeded contract 45e95300-1ba1-4267-8f87-6b999ee5c83a (Шаназаров Мырат №0047390 003370) is fetchable and downloadable with no leftover {{}} placeholders. Frontend (Playwright vs public URL): Dashboard shows stat-total=1, stat-month=1, stat-datasets=8 and the seeded Шаназаров row with dash-dl-* buttons; nav-dashboard/nav-generate/nav-history/nav-settings all navigate; dashboard-new-contract-btn→/generate, dashboard-open-history-btn→/history; History shows seeded contract, history-search filters, preview-{id} opens document-preview-dialog with preview-iframe and preview-open-tab-btn; Settings displays 'Поля автозаполнения (17)' including 'Дополнительно (вручную)' and settings-download-sample-btn present; Generate page loads xlsx via excel-file-input (hidden), auto-maps columns, batch-generate-btn and batch-print-btn render; Edit dialog exposes all 17 field-* testids (including field-note), preview-btn/print-btn/download-pdf-btn/download-docx-btn/save-history-btn; filling field-note='TEST_UI_NoteHello' and downloading the docx yields a file containing both 'Дополнительно' and 'TEST_UI_NoteHello' with no leftover {{}} placeholders.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_fields still exposes 17-field list correctly; /api/contracts endpoints and /api/stats properly exclude _id via projection.
document_service.render_docx passes empty string when key missing — matches docxtpl {%p if note %} conditional so no partial paragraph is emitted when the note is empty (verified).
batch-print preserves selection order via by_id lookup — good UX for merged PDF.
Minor: convert_to_pdf uses fixed 90s timeout per doc; batch-print of many docs could exceed request timeout, but not observed in tests. Consider parallelizing or streaming in the future.
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, has data-testid coverage across all interactive elements, files remain under 400 lines.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: TEST_* contracts created and deleted within test lifecycle. Seeded contract 45e95300-1ba1-4267-8f87-6b999ee5c83a (Шаназаров Мырат) confirmed present and not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_contracts_api.py -v (19 tests, ~10s). Public URL from /app/frontend/.env. Sample xlsx obtainable via GET /api/sample-template. Preview iframe visually appears blank in headless screenshots but backend PDF response is valid — assert via network/testid presence, not pixels.
